purpose: Defines the versioning and stepwise migration design for .doc_structure.yaml, including version detection, migration scripts, CLI behavior and the setup-doc-structure call flow.
summary: Version identifier stored as a YAML comment doc_structure_version X.Y with major/minor semantics
Migration flow, CURRENT_VERSION constant and MIGRATIONS registry with chained idempotent pure functions
Error handling rules: bugs propagate, newer versions skipped, detection failure treated as v1
Procedure for adding a new migration step
Design decision to use text (str) operations because no standard-library YAML parser exists
Conversion specs for v1 to v2 and v2 to v3 migrations
migrate_doc_structure.py CLI modes (default, --dry-run, --check), output spec and exit codes
Responsibility split: script prints to stdout, caller writes files; check_doc_structure.py branching in setup-doc-structure
User settings preservation rules and version detection API
tasks: Modifying .doc_structure.yaml format or bumping its version
Adding a new migration function to the MIGRATIONS registry
Changing setup-doc-structure SKILL flow for existing files
Changing check_doc_structure.py or resolve_doc_structure.py version detection
Writing tests for doc structure migration
